description: This file defines user settings management for a web application, including enums, a class for getting/setting preferences, and functions for exporting/importing settings.

classes.name: UserSettings
classes.description: Provides static methods to get/set user preferences stored in localStorage, including specific getters/setters for various settings.

methods.name: exportUserSettingsBlob
methods.description: Encodes current user settings into a base64 string for export.

methods.name: importUserSettingsBlob
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string and imports user settings if newer than current.
